process_game: process a JSON game object and return a list of data points in training format
remove_duplicated_targets: remove duplicated targets from game frames keeping only the latest tick per unit
process_entry: process a single game entry by attaching target commands to units and assigning unique IDs
reassign_index: reassign unit indices and update target attack and gather indices for a game entry
convert_to_idle: convert a command dictionary to an idle command with all target fields zeroed out
